title: Add a model pricing table with cache discounts

events.content: Add a pricing table in src/pricing.ts with per-million-token rates and a cache read discount.
Added the table and a cost function. Cache reads are billed at ten percent of the input rate.
Cover it with tests in src/pricing.test.ts, including an unknown model that must return no cost instead of zero.
Tests written for known models. TODO: the unknown model case still returns zero, and rounding to four decimals is not applied yet.

open_tasks: unknown model case still returns zero
